topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: This city, it doesn’t give gifts. It demands, it takes, but it doesn’t give. So when that package landed on my desk, wrapped in plain brown paper and tied with twine, something in me hesitated. The tag said, "To Ms. Rand, from Jimmy." Jimmy. I had a Jimmy once, a quiet kid in the back row. One I never thought would make it. I cut the twine, the paper fell away to reveal a framed photograph. It was of us, the class, that last day of school, back when the future looked like sunshine after weeks of rain. I don’t know how he managed to find me, or why after all these years. But here it is, sitting in front of me, a piece of the past that found its way home.
